bio: I'm an Electronics & Communication Engineering student at RVCE, specializing in AI and ML systems. I focus on building things from scratch — transformers, neural nets, custom attention mechanisms — because understanding the internals matters.
My current research interest is in FinTech applications of deep learning, specifically option pricing with neural networks.
